_readme: Verified Ink NFT collections, curated by hand.
Authenticity is not something a blockchain records. Anyone can deploy a
contract called PRTSCN, and several people have. The only way to tell the
real one is for a person who knows the ecosystem to say so - which is what
To add a collection: copy its address from the site (open a row, press
'Copy JSON entry') and paste the line into the list below. Commit the file.
Vercel redeploys on its own and the site picks it up.
Fields: address is required. name is for your own reference only - the site
always shows the name the contract itself reports. x and note are optional.

collections.name: PRTSCN
collections.note: replace or remove - this is the address from your screenshot, confirm it before trusting it
